steps.text: All the eye can see is death.
Endless killing. Life takes life. Fields of corpses, soaked in blood.
The first Nachzehrer learned his purpose when he rose from the ashes of battle.
'I am the end of all things.'

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: 'Penetrate.'
The incantation pierces the Nachzehrer like a lance.
It happened so fast that it was almost impossible to see its trajectory, as though it had taken effect by the time the word left the lips.
A smooth hole appears in Nezzsalem's chest.
There is no change in his expression. Withered branches reach down from his staff, reach into the hole in his torso, and fill in the gap.

a.text: How could this be?
In this battle alone, the young Banshee has casted dozens of Arts that were not of Sarkaz origin.
Ravel, the greatest Arts master of Gaul.
His life's work made the guns of Gaul's ships mighty, and he was famous in all the nations, before the Witch King made his own name known throughout the land.
In that war, there was an instant when the ships of Gaul ripped apart the lines of death like a sharp sword, before death swallowed them.
Why do I see a shadow of him in your Arts?

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: Your words can't kill me.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: The voice that calls me is louder than your incantations by far.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: ...I can hear it.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: The dirge of the fallen echoes within you.
Thousands of war altars, spread across the battlefield.
They absorb what life leaves behind when it dies.
The culmination of the power stands before Logos.
The most powerful Nachzehrer, and the most terrible war altar.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: Nachzehrers witness death.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: We take in all who were brave, friend or foe. In the endless cycle of life and death, they will be remembered and honored.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: Cowards deserve only dust.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: Tell me, my foe—is it a young hero who stands before me, or a despicable traitor?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Your judgment does not interest me.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: This is not where the power of words lie.
Logos once again gathers power in his palm.
A second wound appears on Nezzsalem's body, stretching from the shoulder to his chest.
The incantation does not dissipate. It fends off the branches trying to close in, and prevents the energies of the dead from repairing the Nachzehrer's body.
Shredded cloth rises and falls, covering the new wound, and countless old scars.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: What is this?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Death may feed the Nachzehrer, but the Banshee can put death itself to rest.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: You are no longer the sole master of war, Nezzsalem.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: You're more gifted in incantation than any Banshee I know, Laqeramaline included.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: A shame, though.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: Why do you not sing for the dead, if you truly mourn them?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Elegy cannot actually put the dead to rest.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Neither the living nor the dead will find true rest, as long as war continues.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: Preposterous!

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: You have vanquished the Damazti and banished the Vampire. You, a sovereign of the Royal Court, have Royal Court blood on your hands.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: You dare say it is all because you are avoiding war?

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: Is your rebellion the only reason you stand in my way?
The Nachzehrer floats up in fury. The branches underneath him disintegrate, and decay fills the canyon.
The Banshee's chanting does not give ground.

a.text: Born in death, fueled by war, and nourishing death.
The life of the Nachzehrer is as war itself.
Cities and kingdoms rise and fall, but the fate of the Nachzehrer never changes.
Once, a Nachzehrer clan, tired of the cycle, put down their swords and staves and went into the depths of the wastes, far from civilization.
Their powers declined rapidly in peace, and they soon became prey for others, fading away in a forgotten corner of the land.
There is no other way to ensure the continued existence of the Nachzehrers.
The great rock of war sits above our heads on the slopes of time. All we can do is to push it with all our strength.
Such cycle has continued for thousands of years.
Until—
We promise a war, Nachzehrer King—
About the future, and nothing else.
My best students, the young twin royals. I taught them the laws of war. They stood before me and told me—
We can end the monotony of war and break the rigid cycle.
We can push the rock to the top of the mountain and build a splendid palace with it.
This war will be my blaze of glory.
It must not end here!
That was a long time ago.
Now, a young Banshee stands before me.
How could they be so alike?

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: I fought alongside Laqeramaline for decades, across cities and plains. We buried the armor of Victoria and the guns of Gaul beneath the walls of Kazdel together.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: In the same battle, I helped Theresa take the heads of thousands of Leithanian casters.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: They were the heroes of Kazdel, its greatest warriors.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: Laqeramaline entrusted you with the future of the Banshees. Theresa considered you one of her best students.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: But you hid at Rhodes Island, sheltered the King of Sarkaz, and sneaked into Londinium like a thief, content to sabotage the cracks in the battlefield...

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: War will not end the suffering of the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: All I see is you dragging everyone into the abyss.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: So you chose to run.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: Many years ago, I said to Theresa that war was unavoidable. If it did not come to Londinium, it would come to Kazdel.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: Theresa agreed, but continued to hope that there could be another solution.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: Her choice led to a new war. Its consequence was the death of the King of Sarkaz.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: I witnessed her death. All Sarkaz should honor her.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: What can you bring the Sarkaz aside from these meek words? What do you want to bring the Sarkaz?
He points his staff at the ground.
The scent of decay rushes out, overpowering the barrier of incantations.

steps.name: Sudaram
steps.text: (Growls)
The dirge of the myriad souls grows louder.
The power of the incantations is weakening. He feels his fingers, lips and tongue go numb.
The fury does not come only from the ancient Royal Court sovereign before him.
It is also coming from his own blood.
I told you.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Duq'arael. I witnessed with my own eyes...

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: ...My death?

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: You and the King both know you can't kill me.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: With your help, I've come to an... interesting place. It is not all nothingness beyond history.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: But I continue to gaze at you beyond the veil.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: You have come so far, little Banshee... you and the Outblood King seek the drop of blood that I left behind.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: The Blood of Teekaz... the pure blood that I coveted.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: You believe that you can prevent calamity from occurring again by destroying it.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: It's true.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: 'True'. Destroy the altar, put a temporary stop to the Cunabula of Suffering, allow the Victorian nitwits to cling to life a bit longer. How boring.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: Who is the one that's short-sighted and foolish here?

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: You feel it, don't you? You're closely linked to the altar. Right here, right now, your power is being boosted by it.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: It was never one drop of blood or a single person's call that awakened the Cunabula of Suffering.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: Originium is the response to the call of all Sarkaz, living and dead. No exceptions.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: ...The murmur of the myriad souls is omnipresent.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: The lament of the dead will not stop.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: The Sarkaz are bound by the past from the moment of their birth, never to be freed, even unto death.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: You witnessed the myriad souls the first time you sang an elegy... Laqeramaline proudly described your talent to us.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: This talent was the seed of dissent.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: You feel pain, not just for others, but for yourself as well. You may detest the path I walk, but you could not help but feel sorrow for me sake.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I feel sorrow for how you're trapped by the past.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: Such arrogance... I should try to kill you again.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: But instead, I will bless you.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: The slaughterer and the slaughtered... they are all part of the cycle.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: I am here because of you.
Logos does not smell any blood.
The incantation easily impales the Sanguinarch's body, causing only a few small ripples.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Your blood is still linked to my elegy.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: Of course... of course. You stand with me, no matter how much you resist.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: We are all sovereigns of the Royal Court, after all... the oldest bloodlines of the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: I should be glad that you could conquer me, for it proves that you are stronger, and more worthy of carrying the fate of the Sarkaz, leading them on your path.
The Sanguinarch of Vampires laughs, turning around and disappearing into the cave.
His silhouette fades away amongst the Originium crystals, but his voice continues to echo in Logos's ear.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: Bless you, Aefanyl, my vanquisher.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: Assimilate my blood. Utilize my power. Let your hatred of me fuel your battles!

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: You will walk in my place and witness in my stead how far the flames of Sarkaz vengeance will burn.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Refuse.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Nachzehrer, Vampire, we all hear the same cry.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: The fate of the Sarkaz is caught in a cycle, and I am no exception.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I am part of what I'm fighting.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: The fury of the Sarkaz burns within my veins and my viscera.
Words turn into fire, descending from the sky to ignite every seed on the earth.
Incantations burn at Logos's fingertips, on his lips, in his chest.
Originium crystals grow furiously around him, and the crying of the dead becomes even louder, ready to accept him and devour him at any time.
He no longer rejects the power in his blood. The Vampire has guided the flames of the Sarkaz to him, and he has embraced the fire.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: 'The abyss lies before us. We can fill it with flesh, and burn the remnants with blood.'

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: If the only way to bring new life is to burn away all the decay, then I will be both flame and fuel.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: This is where my blood belongs, that I have chosen.
Flames consume the entire canyon.
The only things left are the incantations that the young Banshee has written his entire life, from a very young age.
They surround Logos loyally, his sword and shield.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: If war is the only way to achieve the dream, and new life can only emerge from death...

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I shall bring death.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I shall welcome death.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I shall ignite my past with blood, not for vengeance—

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: But for the day when this fire will burn away what shackles the Sarkaz, through the decay that covers the land.
A bone whistle sounds.
Logos knows that it is merely the echo of the bone whistle in the Valley of the Banshees, the night he set out for Babel.
From death comes new life.
The death knell rings.
For the Royal Court that would rot, past and future, and for himself.
